title: Earthy Bean Stir Fry
description: A hearty and nutritious stir fry made with earthy mushrooms, creamy sauce, and protein-rich beans.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts and cook until they're tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the black beans, soy sauce, and ground ginger. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped green onions or sesame seeds, if desired.
